name: Circle Mask
goal: Generate a circular shape using texture coordinates and SphereMask.
finalVisualResult: A white circular mask on a black background.
nodeRelationships: TexCoord provides UV coordinates to SphereMask input A.
ScalarParameters define the Center, Radius, and Hardness.
SphereMask outputs a circular gradient based on distance.
FinalColor renders the output to the Viewport.
commonMistakes: Using incorrect coordinates for B (center). Should default to (0.5, 0.5).
Setting radius larger than 0.5, causing clipping at bounds.
expectedBehavior: Radius scales the circle size; Hardness sharpens or softens the edges.
motionPreview: Solid white circle on a black background.
colorPreview: Solid white circle on a black background.

name: Size Change
goal: Vary mask size dynamically using a ScalarParameter scaling texture coordinates.
nodeRelationships: TexCoord feeds Multiply.
ScalarParameter scales coordinates, altering texture tiling/scale.
Multiply output feeds FinalColor.
commonMistakes: Multiplying UV by 0, which collapses the texture to a single pixel color.
expectedBehavior: Higher scale tiling values shrink the visual output, while lower values enlarge it.

name: Color Blending
goal: Blend vector color and scalar mask to colorize shape output.
finalVisualResult: A solid color shape on a background.
nodeRelationships: VectorParameter feeds A of Multiply.
ScalarParameter/Mask feeds B of Multiply.
Multiply combines mask intensity and color.
commonMistakes: Using Add instead of Multiply, which bleeds color into the background.
expectedBehavior: Output color matches VectorParameter multiplied by Fade scalar.

name: Pulse Animation
goal: Animate brightness periodically over time using Sine.
finalVisualResult: A continuously pulsating light that fades in and out.
nodeRelationships: Time is multiplied by Speed.
Sine maps input to a -1..1 oscillation range.
Add offsets result so it pulses within a positive range (e.g. 0.3..1.0).
commonMistakes: Connecting Time directly to Emissive, causing blinding values over time.
Neglecting Sine remapping, resulting in negative color values.
expectedBehavior: Higher speed increases pulse rate; Intensity changes wave depth.

name: Circular Telegraph
goal: Assemble an animated circular indicator that combines coordinate masks, time pulsing, and linear interpolation.
finalVisualResult: A warning circle with a soft edge, pulsing in size and brightness in red-orange.
nodeRelationships: TexCoord feeds SphereMask coordinate A.
ScalarParameters shape Radius, Edge softness, Fade.
Time * Speed fed to Sine creates a remapped 0..1 Pulse.
Multiply combines the static Mask with the dynamic Pulse.
Lerp blends the base floor color with the warning color using the final mask.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to clamp the final mask, causing unexpected color bloom in HDR.
expectedBehavior: A pulsing soft-edged glowing disk on a dark background.

name: Box Mask
goal: Generate a rectangular box shape using texture coordinates and a BoxMask node.
finalVisualResult: A white rectangular box mask on a black background.
nodeRelationships: TexCoord provides UV coordinates to BoxMask input A.
ScalarParameters define the Center, Width, Height, and Hardness.
BoxMask outputs a rectangular box gradient based on bounds.
FinalColor renders the output to the Viewport.
commonMistakes: Setting size larger than 0.5, causing clipping at bounds.
expectedBehavior: Width and Height scale the box bounds; Hardness sharpens or softens the edges.
motionPreview: Solid white box on a black background.
colorPreview: Solid white box on a black background.

name: Cone Mask
goal: Generate a directional spotlight/cone (sector) projection shape.
finalVisualResult: A linear white-to-black sector gradient projecting straight forward from the bottom center.
nodeRelationships: TexCoord provides UV coordinates to ConeMask input A.
ScalarParameters define the Radius (range) and Angle (spread).
ConeMask outputs a linear gradient decline inside the V-angle sector.
FinalColor renders the output to the Viewport.
commonMistakes: Forgetting that the cone projects in a specific direction (upward), so it is not symmetric in all directions.
expectedBehavior: Radius controls far reach; Angle controls the wedge spread.

name: Cone Telegraph
goal: Create a cone-shaped (sector) telegraph warning indicator projecting forward from a boss position.
finalVisualResult: A glowing orange-red sector/cone telegraph pulsing in intensity.
nodeRelationships: TexCoord provides UV coordinates to ConeMask input A.
ScalarParameter B defines the origin of the cone (e.g., bottom-center).
ConeMask outputs a sector-shaped projection with radius and angle.
Time * Speed fed to Sine creates a pulsating animation.
Multiply combines the static ConeMask with the dynamic pulse.
Lerp blends warning color with floor color based on the pulsing mask.

requiredParameters.name: Cone Angle
requiredParameters.description: Cone projection spread angle in degrees.

commonMistakes: Setting origin B in the center when shooting forward, which makes it look like it's cut in half.
expectedBehavior: A 90-degree sector shooting upward, pulsing in orange-red intensity.

name: Box Telegraph
goal: Create a rectangular lane telegraph warning indicator (lane AoE) projecting forward from a boss position.
finalVisualResult: A glowing orange-red rectangular lane telegraph pulsing in intensity.
nodeRelationships: TexCoord provides UV coordinates to BoxMask input A.
ScalarParameters define Width, Height, and Hardness.
BoxMask outputs a rectangular lane shape.
Time * Speed fed to Sine creates a pulsating animation.
Multiply combines the static BoxMask with the dynamic pulse.
Lerp blends warning color with floor color based on the pulsing mask.
commonMistakes: Confusing half-width/height with full size, causing the box to be twice as large as expected.
expectedBehavior: A rectangular warning lane pulsing in orange-red intensity.

name: Liquid Gauge
goal: Create a dynamic liquid gauge or hunger bar using waving sine math and a step function.
finalVisualResult: A yellow liquid that waves and fills up a circular container based on a percentage.
nodeRelationships: TexCoord is split into horizontal (R) and vertical (G).
Time creates two scrolling sine waves with different speeds and amplitudes.
The Step node creates a sharp surface level based on the Percent parameter.
RadialGradient is used as a container mask.
commonMistakes: Swapping the X and Y inputs of the Step node, causing the liquid to render upside down.
expectedBehavior: Liquid waves horizontally and its height is controlled by the Percent slider.
colorPreview: Yellow waving liquid in a circle.
